title: Intro to C++
line: Strings, vectors, references and classes in modern C++.

project.title: A deck of cards
project.brief: Write cards.cpp on your own. A Card class, a vector that holds all 52 cards, a function that deals five into a hand by reference, and the hand printed in rank order.
checks: The hand of five prints sorted by rank

lessons.title: Compile and run your first program
lessons.goal: Teach a complete beginner to write banner.cpp in VS Code with iostream and std::cout, compile it with clang++ -std=c++17 and run it to print a name in a box of stars.
lessons.passes: The program prints three lines, a name between two rows of stars.

lessons.title: Variables, types and cout
lessons.goal: Teach C++ int, double, bool, const and auto with arithmetic by building a download time estimator from a file size and a connection speed.
lessons.passes: A 600 megabyte file at 20 megabytes a second prints 30 seconds.

lessons.title: Strings
lessons.goal: Teach std::string in C++, with size, find, substr and replace, by writing a word censor that swaps one word in a sentence for stars.
lessons.passes: The sentence prints with the chosen word replaced by stars.

lessons.title: If, for and while
lessons.goal: Teach C++ if, else, for and while by writing a coin change counter that breaks an amount in cents into the fewest quarters, dimes, nickels and pennies.
lessons.passes: 87 cents prints 3 quarters, 1 dime, 0 nickels and 2 pennies.

lessons.title: Functions
lessons.goal: Teach C++ functions with parameters, return types, default arguments and overloading by writing time helpers that turn seconds into hours, minutes and seconds.
lessons.passes: 3725 seconds prints 1 hour, 2 minutes and 5 seconds.

lessons.title: References and const
lessons.goal: Teach C++ references and const references by writing heal and damage functions that change a health bar in place and a print function that only reads it.
lessons.passes: Heal and damage take a reference and the print function a const reference.

lessons.title: Vectors
lessons.goal: Teach std::vector in C++, with push_back, size, indexing and the range for loop, by logging lap times and printing the fastest lap and the average.
lessons.passes: The fastest lap and the average match the times in the vector.

lessons.title: Maps
lessons.goal: Teach std::map in C++, with insert, lookup, find and looping over pairs, by building a fruit stand price list and totalling an order.
lessons.passes: The order total matches the prices in the map and a missing fruit is reported.

lessons.title: Classes
lessons.goal: Teach C++ classes with private members, a constructor and const member functions by building a Fraction class that adds two fractions and simplifies the result.
lessons.passes: One half plus one third prints 5/6.

lessons.title: Sort and lambdas
lessons.goal: Teach std::sort, std::find_if and lambdas from the C++ algorithm header by building a leaderboard that sorts players by score, highest first.
lessons.passes: The players print from highest score to lowest, sorted with a lambda.
